app.title: AI Project Blueprint Architect
app.subtitle: Define the cognitive structure for AI to work accurately for you
app.review_desc: Review the blueprint and copy/download it to use with your AI
app.usage_title: How to use this Blueprint for Vibe Coding
app.usage_desc: Copy the markdown text below and paste it into any AI tool (e.g., Gemini, ClaudeCode, OpenCode, or CloudCowork). Start your prompt with:
app.usage_prompt: Here is my project blueprint. Please use this as context to help me code/design my application...
app.ai_error: AI service timeout. Please copy your blueprint and use it directly with ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude!
app.ai_error_network: Could not connect to AI service. Please copy your blueprint and use it directly with ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude!

q_project_desc.title: Describe your project briefly
q_project_desc.description: Tell us what you want to build or achieve
q_project_desc.placeholder: e.g., A mobile app that helps local farmers sell produce directly to consumers...

q_purpose.title: What will you use this Blueprint for?
q_purpose.description: Select your main purpose so we can tailor the questions

vibe-coding.label: Build an app or website with AI
vibe-coding.desc: Let AI write code for you using tools like ClaudeCode, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot
vibe-coding.scenario: You want to build an online store but can't code. Just describe what you want and AI builds it for you — no coding skills needed.

business-planning.label: Plan a business or revenue model
business-planning.desc: Create a business plan, revenue model, or Business Model Canvas
business-planning.scenario: You want to open a coffee shop but need to plan it out. This Blueprint helps you organize your thinking — who are your customers, what do you sell, and where does revenue come from.

campaign-strategy.label: Plan a campaign or social strategy
campaign-strategy.desc: Plan a campaign, advocacy project, or social initiative
campaign-strategy.scenario: Your NGO wants to run a plastic reduction campaign. You need a Blueprint to organize the strategy, target audience, and communication channels.

pitch-prep.label: Prepare a Pitch Deck or presentation
pitch-prep.desc: Prepare materials for investors or executives
pitch-prep.scenario: You're pitching to a VC and need a Blueprint that organizes everything — from problem and solution to market size and revenue model.
